top_violation_types.title: CPR Training and Recertification Adhere to Guidelines-skill based (26 TAC §746.1315(b)(1))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The on-line CPR recertification training obtain did not include use of a CPR manikin.

top_violation_types.title: Requirements for Feeding Infants - Label Bottles/Cups (26 TAC §746.2419(6))
Supervision ensures each child?s safety, well-being, including physical proximity and auditory or visual awareness of each child?s on going activity (26 TAC §746.1205(a)(4))
Report Situation Placing Children at Risk (26 TAC §746.305(a)(6))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: A report was not made to Child Care Regulation for an incident that potentially posed a risk to children.

top_violation_types.title: Incident/Illness Report Form Shared with Parent (26 TAC §746.707)
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The incident report was not signed by the parent.

top_violation_types.title: Responsibilities of Caregivers - Know number of children responsible for (26 TAC §746.1205(a)(2))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: Two caregivers did not know how many children they were responsible for.

top_violation_types.title: AP Responsibilities of Employees and Caregivers -Ensure No Child Abused, Neglected, or Exploited (26 TAC §746.1201(4))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: This standard was found deficient as part of a DFPS Investigation.

top_violation_types.title: Report Change in Director (26 TAC §746.303(a)(4))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The operation failed to notify Licensing of a change in director.
